messages.content: What color clothes did the first man on the glass roof wear?
Green.
What shade was the clothing of the man who emerged from the next roof?
Green.
How did the man on the roof avoid falling when he stepped off the edge?
He walked on the air.
What did the rooftop stranger do after Dorothy warned that he would fall?
He walked on the air.
Why did the crowd ignore the children as the balloon descended?
Same size as the Mangaboos.
Why did Dorothy and Zeb blend in at the balloon landing?
Same size as the Mangaboos.
Where was Eureka sleeping while the crowd watched the falling balloon?
On the buggy seat.
What spot did Eureka curl up in while the balloon came down?
On the buggy seat.
What must be done to a Mangaboo who starts to sprout?
They must be planted at once.
What happens when a Mangaboo has the misfortune of sprouting?
They must be planted at once.
What plant did all the Mangaboo princes grow on?
The Royal Bush.
Name the bush where the Mangaboo rulers grew.
The Royal Bush.
How did the Mangaboos get their clothing?
It grew on their bodies.
How did clothes appear on a Mangaboo growing in the garden?
It grew on their bodies.
What did the tangled Clinging Vines look like from above?
A nest of snakes.
What did the writhing vines in the enclosed garden resemble?
A nest of snakes.
What did they hear as they approached the nearest cottage in Voe?
A bird twittering.
What unseen sound came from a bird in the valley near the cottage?
A bird twittering.
Why did the Wizard guess the Gargoyles were keeping them alive?
For a ceremony.
What did the Wizard think the wooden people were saving the prisoners for?
For a ceremony.
What did Eureka say the dragonettes' mouths looked like?
Coal-scuttles.
What did the kitten compare the mouths of the cave creatures to?
Coal-scuttles.
How far back did the dragonette say its family could be traced?
About twenty thousand years.
How many years old was the family line of the dragonettes?
About twenty thousand years.
What role did Ozma offer the Wizard in her kingdom?
Official Wizard.
What job did Ozma give the old man when she offered him a home?
Official Wizard.
What did Jim eat when the Lion asked whether he had breakfasted?
Clover.
What did the real horse nibble while talking to the Lion and Tiger?
Clover.
How many lawyers lived in Oz when Eureka was arrested?
None.
Were there any lawyers in the Land of Oz before the kitten's trial?
None.
What did the Braided Man give Dorothy in exchange for the ribbon?
A box of rustles.
Which gift did Dorothy receive after making the Braided Man happy?
A box of rustles.
Name the color of the man's clothes when he appeared on the next rooftop.
Green.
What color was the fitted outfit worn by the first rooftop man?
Green.
Which color did the sunlight bring out on the stranger's clothes?
Green.
What did the glass-city man do instead of falling from the roof?
He walked on the air.
How did the man get away once he reached the end of the roof?
He walked on the air.
Describe the stranger's movement when he stepped into space.
He walked on the air.
Why were the visitors' children not singled out at the balloon's approach?
Same size as the Mangaboos.
What made Dorothy and Zeb look ordinary in the crowd by the balloon?
Same size as the Mangaboos.
Why did the earth children not stand out to the people watching the sky?
Same size as the Mangaboos.
Where had the kitten fallen asleep at the House of the Sorcerer?
On the buggy seat.
Where was Eureka curled up while the others waited for the balloon?
On the buggy seat.
What part of the buggy did Eureka use as a bed beside Jim?
On the buggy seat.
What does the Prince require when one of his people begins to sprout?
They must be planted at once.
If a Mangaboo puts out shoots, what must happen to it immediately?
They must be planted at once.
What do the Mangaboos do when someone sprouts like a potato?
They must be planted at once.
Where do the Mangaboo royal family members come from?
The Royal Bush.
What single bush produced the rulers of the glass city?
The Royal Bush.
Which plant was pointed out as the source of the Mangaboo princes?
The Royal Bush.
What did the garden reveal about the origin of a Mangaboo's clothes?
It grew on their bodies.
How do the jackets and other garments get onto the Mangaboo plants?
It grew on their bodies.
How is a Mangaboo's clothing attached to the person?
It grew on their bodies.
What animal shape did the mass of clinging vines evoke?
A nest of snakes.
From the air, what did the knot of moving garden vines resemble?
A nest of snakes.
How does the book describe the way the clinging vines looked together?
A nest of snakes.
What animal noise did they notice on their way to the first Voe cottage?
A bird twittering.
What could the travelers hear on the path even though they saw no animal?
A bird twittering.
What made the twittering noise near the cottage in Voe?
A bird twittering.
What purpose did the Wizard suspect when the Gargoyles took prisoners?
For a ceremony.
Why did the Wizard think they were captured instead of killed?
For a ceremony.
What did the Wizard guess the wooden folk had in store for their captives?
For a ceremony.
What object did the kitten say the cavern creatures' mouths resembled?
Coal-scuttles.
Fill in Eureka's description: the cave creatures had mouths like what?
Coal-scuttles.
Name the object Eureka used to describe the dragonettes' mouths.
Coal-scuttles.
How many millennia did the dragonette claim for its family tree?
About twenty thousand years.
When did the dragonette say its long family history began, in years?
About twenty thousand years.
How old a family line did the dragonette boast about?
About twenty thousand years.
What title did Ozma promise the Wizard when she offered him a place in Oz?
Official Wizard.
Name the post Ozma gave the retired circus performer.
Official Wizard.
What would the Wizard become in the service of Ozma?
Official Wizard.
What was Jim's breakfast when he met Dorothy's friends the Lion and Tiger?
Clover.
Name the plant Jim found to eat after the Lion spoke to him.
Clover.
What did the real horse find was plentiful enough for breakfast?
Clover.
Was there a lawyer available in Oz when the kitten was to be tried?
None.
Give the number of lawyers in Oz before Eureka's trial.
None.
At the time of Eureka's arrest, did any lawyers live in Oz?
None.
Name the Braided Man's thank-you present for Dorothy.
A box of rustles.
What box did the Braided Man give the girl who fetched his ribbon?
A box of rustles.
Which of the Braided Man's products did he offer to Dorothy?
A box of rustles.
